label: KYOTO SPOT GUIDE
title: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove: get there before 8

cards.label: WHEN TO GO
cards.head: Quiet: 7 to 8 a.m.
cards.body: Busy from about 8 a.m., when the path turns into a slow line.

cards.label: OPEN
cards.head: Always open, and free
cards.body: No gate, no ticket. Whoever arrives early wins.

cards.label: TIP
cards.head: Take your photos while it is quiet
cards.body: At busy times, stopping on the narrow path blocks everyone behind you.

cards.label: PLAN
cards.head: Give Arashiyama its own morning
cards.body: It is on the opposite side of the city from Gion and Kiyomizu. Walk on to Togetsukyo Bridge after.
